catalog_quote: 5.2 Stress. Stress in Dobu is non-phonemic in 2-syllable words occurring on the penultimate syllable. In many 3-syllable words it falls on the antepenultimate. In some such 3-syllable words, stress fluctuates; in others it is fixed. /ona/ ['ona] 'word' /tana/ ['tʰana] 'basket' /pou/ ['pʰou] 'egg' /tetela/ [tʰe'tʰela] 'story' /bagula/ ['bagula] 'garden' /tamagu/ ['tʰamagu/tʰa'magu] 'my father'. In words of more than 3 syllables, the stress patterns can be regarded as combinations of 2- or 3-syllable segments, with the characteristic stress patterns of such. ... Two-syllable words: CV.V 'po.u 'egg'; CV.CV 'ni.ma 'hand'; V.CV 'a.ba 'creeper type'. Three-syllable words: V.CV.V e'ta.i 'harvest'; V.CV.CV e'ta.la 'python'; CV.CV.CV gi'da.ba 'stick insect'; CV.V.CV 'ma.i.na 'bad smell'. Four-syllable words: CV.V.CV.V 2+2 'wa.i 'wa.i 'to be strong'; V.CV.CV.V 2+2 'e.si'nu.a 'to choose'. ... [p.9…
